summary: Removed ConditionSet._eval_subs special handling that incorrectly tested the replacement value against the base set after a condition became true; reconstruction now returns the substituted base set through normal constructor simplification. Added issue 19495 ImageSet regressions covering plain/simultaneous substitution, xreplace, false and symbolic conditions, plus an interval regression, and corrected an existing expectation encoding the bug. Reproduced the original failure before the change. Public tests: test_conditionset.py 10 passed, 1 expected failure; sympy/sets/tests and sympy/solvers/tests/test_solveset.py 305 passed, 3 skipped, 19 expected failures. Reviewed final diff.
